title: Simplifying square roots of square roots by denesting

\textbf{FT.} Practical recursive square-root methods and an expression-complexity measure distinct from ordinary radical depth. Another explicit reference for SymPy's implementation.

\entrynote{A practical bridge from square-root theory to implementable procedures. Particularly relevant to SymPy's documented algorithmic lineage and to selected simplification strategies in other systems.}
